name: deepseek_v2_moe_layer_shuffled_16x16_model_dim6144_n_routed256_inter_dim256
description: sglang's DeepseekV2DecoderLayer after its attention, on one rank, with MXFP4 experts: the residual stream hidden_states through post_attention_layernorm, then on it each token's topk experts by sigmoid score plus correction_bias, weighed by the renormalized unbiased scores times routed_scaling_factor, and the shared expert in the last slot at weight 1, each expert down(silu(gate(x)) * up(x)) of its MXFP4 weights (fused_moe's: fp4 values at an e8m0 scale per 32); out is hidden_states plus their output summed over the ranks of the kernel's peer memory in rank order, the stream after the layer.

n_experts.description: Expert slots: the routed experts, then the shared one.

gate_up_rows.description: w1 rows: gate and up concatenated.

hidden_states.description: The residual stream after the attention.

correction_bias.description: Added to the scores to pick experts; never weighs them.

w1.description: Gate-up projection per expert: gate rows, then up rows.

out.description: The residual stream after the layer.
